original: そこをどけ
traducao: Out of my way.

original: フン、それが人にものを頼む態度か？
traducao: Hmph. Is that any way to ask someone?

original: どうやら、人として\n最低限の礼儀というものを\n教わって来なかった様だな
traducao: It seems you were never taught\neven the most basic manners\nbefitting a human being.

original: 国の客員剣士が聞いて呆れる
traducao: Some guest swordsman of the kingdom.

original: 何だと？
traducao: What did you say?

original: あっ、ごっめ〜〜ん！
traducao: Ah, soooorry~!

original: ……気を付けろ！
traducao: ...Watch where you're going!

original: ぷ……くっくく……\nあは、あははははは！
traducao: Pfft... Hehehe...\nAha, ahahahahaha!

original: あんた、髪、\nすごい、事に、なってるぅ！
traducao: Your hair is, like,\ntotally sticking up all over!
What!?

original: うわ、リオンすげー！\nどうしたんだその頭？
traducao: Whoa, Leon, that's wild!\nWhat happened to your hair?

original: 静電気だよ……。\n多分、ノーマが\nキールの薄い板でこすったんだ
traducao: It's static electricity...\nNorma probably rubbed it\nwith Keele's plastic board.

original: 最近、このイタズラ\n流行ってるみたいなんだよね
traducao: That prank seems to be\ngetting pretty popular lately.

original: 貴様……覚悟は出来ているんだろうな
traducao: You... I hope you're prepared to die.

original: おい待て、待つんだ！
traducao: Hey, hold it! Stop right there!

original: あんな古典的なイタズラに\n引っかかるなんて
traducao: To fall for such a\nclassic prank, though...

original: リオンもあれで結構、\n子どもっぽいところがあるんだね
traducao: Leon actually has quite a\nchildish side to him, doesn't he?

original: ほんとだなぁ
traducao: He sure does.

original: なぁ、リオン……\n一つ聞きたい事があるんだが
traducao: Hey, Leon...\nMind if I ask you a quick question?

original: 断る
traducao: Refuse

original: って、早ッ！！
traducao: Whoa, that was fast!!

original: せめて質問の内容くらい\n聞いたっていいだろ！？
traducao: You could at least hear\nwhat the question is, couldn't ya!?

original: 答える必要がどこにある。\n時間の無駄だ
traducao: Why should I answer you?\nIt is a complete waste of time.

original: まあまあそうおっしゃらず
traducao: Come on now, don't be like that!

original: リオンに骨董集めの趣味があるのか\nそれがど〜〜しても知りたくてさ
traducao: I just really, REALLY gotta know\nif you're into collecting antiques, Leon.

original: ……？\nどういう意味だ、それは？
traducao: ...?\nWhat is that supposed to mean?

original: いやぁ、例えば変な仮面とか\n骸骨みたいな仮面とか
traducao: Like, say, weird masks,\nor skull-shaped masks...

original: いまいち顔が隠れてない仮面の\n収集癖とか骨董の趣味が\nあったりなかったりしないかな〜と……
traducao: I was wondering if maybe you have\na habit of collecting masks that\nbarely hide your face at all...

original: 双連撃！
traducao: Twin Assault!

original: のはぁっ！　痛ぇ！？
traducao: Gwaaah! That hurts!?

original: チッ、急所は外したか……\nだが次は外さん
traducao: Tch, I missed the vitals...\nNext time, I will not miss.

original: 事情はよくわからんが……\nこいつがいけ好かないのには同感だ
traducao: I do not quite follow the context,\nbut I agree that this guy is obnoxious.

original: 手を貸そう
traducao: Allow me to assist.

original: ちょ、ちょっとお二人さん？\nいやだなぁ、そんなにギラギラして\nどうなさいまし……
traducao: H-Hold on a second, you two!\nNo need to glare at me with eyes\nfull of murder, what's got into--

original: ぎょえええ！\n死ぬ、死ぬ〜〜〜ッ！！！
traducao: GYAAAH!!\nI'm dead, I'm deeeaaad!!!

original: お前は一度……
traducao: You need to...

original: 地獄に落ちろ！
traducao: Go to hell!
......What is it?

original: ……あ……その……\n間違っていたらごめんなさい
traducao: ...Ah... um...\nForgive me if I am mistaken, but...

original: もしかして……\n船酔い……されていますか？
traducao: Could it be that you are...\nseasick...?

original: ……何を言うかと思えば……。\n……くだらんな……
traducao: ...I wondered what you were getting at...\n...Ridiculous...

original: ほら、やっぱり\n具合が悪いんじゃないですか！
traducao: See, you really are\nnot feeling well at all!

original: ……っ、僕に構うな！
traducao: ...Tch, leave me alone!

original: いいえ、構います！\nそれがわたしの仕事ですから
traducao: No, I will not!\nTaking care of you is my job!

original: 待っていて下さい、すぐに\n酔い止めの薬を持って来ます
traducao: Please wait here. I will go fetch\nsome medicine for seasickness right away.

original: ……この船の奴らは……\nバカばかり……だ
traducao: ...Everyone on this ship...\nis an absolute... fool...

original: あっ。\nこんな所にいた
traducao: Ah!\nThere you are!

original: リオン！　\n何してるの？
traducao: Leon!\nWhat are you up to?

original: 次、リオンの番だよ。\n部屋に戻って、続きしよ？
traducao: It's your turn next, Leon!\nCome back to the room and keep playing!

original: 断る
traducao: Refuse

original: どうして僕がお前達と\nばば抜きなんかしなければならないんだ
traducao: Why on earth should I have to play\na game like Old Maid with you people?

original: だって、みんなで遊んだ方が面白いじゃない
traducao: Because playing together is much more fun!

original: だったら僕以外の人間とやればいい
traducao: Then play with anyone other than me.

original: やだ！\nリオンとやろうと思って\nカード持って来たんだから
traducao: No way!\nI brought these cards specifically\nso I could play with you, Leon!

original: そんな事、僕には関係……
traducao: That has nothing to do with me...

original: ここ、色んな人がいて\nちょっと馴染むのは大変かもしれないけど\nでも、みんないい人ばっかりなんだよ
traducao: There are so many different people here,\nso fitting in might feel tough at first,\nbut everyone here is truly wonderful!

original: せっかくこうして出会えたんだもん。\nリオンにもみんなのいいところとか\n楽しいところを一杯知って欲しいよ
traducao: Since we had the chance to meet,\nI want you to see the good sides of\neveryone and have lots of fun, Leon!

original: …………一回だけだ。\nそれ以上は付き合わんぞ
traducao: ......Just one round.\nI will not play any more than that.

original: うん、それでも十分だよ！\nありがと、リオン
traducao: Yeah, that's more than enough!\nThanks, Leon!

original: フン、全く……
traducao: Hmph, honestly...

original: やっぱり、みんなで一緒が楽しいよね
traducao: Doing things together really is the best!

original: さ、行こ！
traducao: Come on, let's go!

original: お、おい。\n引っ張るな！\n自分で歩ける！
traducao: H-Hey!\nDon't pull me!\nI can walk on my own!

original: あら、リオンさん？
traducao: Oh, Leon?

original: 何をしているの？
traducao: What are you doing?

original: その紅茶の缶は……
traducao: That tea tin in your hands is...

original: 何でもいいだろう。\n僕に構うな！
traducao: It doesn't concern you.\nLeave me alone!

original: お茶を淹れようとしていたのね。\n邪魔をしてしまって、ごめんなさい
traducao: You were trying to brew tea.\nI'm sorry for interrupting you.

original: リオンさん、もしかして\n最近よく眠れていないの？
traducao: Leon, have you perhaps\nbeen having trouble sleeping lately?

original: なぜそんな事を聞く
traducao: Why do you ask that?

original: その茶葉はね、リラックス効果が高いの。\nだから、寝る前に飲むと\n疲れがほぐれて、とってもよく眠れるのよ
traducao: Those tea leaves are very relaxing.\nDrinking it before bed eases fatigue\nand helps you sleep soundly.

original: もしかして、贈り物だったのかしら？\nご家族から？
traducao: Could it be a present?\nFrom your family, perhaps?

original: ……フン。\nどうだかな……
traducao: ...Hmph.\nWho knows...

original: いいご家族がいるのね。\n素敵だわ
traducao: You must have a wonderful family.\nThat is lovely.

original: ……おい。\nこの紅茶は、どう淹れれば\n一番美味くなる？
traducao: ...Hey.\nHow should this black tea be brewed\nto make it taste best?

original: まずは茶器を\nあたためる事から始めるの。\nこうして、熱湯で中を満たして……
traducao: First, you begin by warming the pot.\nLike this, fill the inside\nwith boiling water...

original: ……ッ、熱い！
traducao: ...Ow! Hot!

original: ほら、気を付けて
traducao: There now, be careful!

original: こ……子ども扱いするな
traducao: D-Don't treat me like a child!

original: ……そうね。\nごめんなさい
traducao: ...You're right.\nI'm sorry.

original: 私も、次から気を付けるわ
traducao: I'll be more careful next time, too.
*yaaawn*~~~~~

original: 大きなアクビですねえ。\nあんまり眠れていないんですか？
traducao: That was a huge yawn.\nHaven't you been sleeping well?

original: 違う違〜う！　\nその逆だっての
traducao: No, nooo!\nIt's the complete opposite!

original: あんまりにも心地良くて\nぜ〜んぜん起きられなかったのよ
traducao: It was so comfortable that\nI couldn't get up at all!

original: ……フン。\n「春眠暁を覚えず」、というやつか
traducao: ...Hmph. "In spring, one sleeps,\nunaware of the dawn," as they say?

original: え？　\nしゅんしゅんみんみん？\nなんだって？？？
traducao: Huh?\nIn spring, what dawns?\nWhat does that even mean???

original: 「春眠暁を覚えず」です！
traducao: "In spring, sleep knows no dawn!"

original: 春の夜は気持ち良く眠れるので、\nなかなか起きられないって意味ですよ
traducao: Spring nights bring pleasant sleep,\nso it means it's hard to wake up!

original: は〜、なるほどねえ。\nさっすがリー坊、洒落た事言うわ〜。\nうんうん……
traducao: Aaah, I see, I see!\nLeave it to little Leon-kins\nto say something so classy. Mhm, mhm...

original: ……ん、でも、今って別に\n春とか関係ないわよね？
traducao: ...Wait, spring has nothing\nto do with right now, does it?

original: お前の頭の中を除けばな
traducao: Except for inside your own head.

original: なるほどね！\nあたしの頭は春の陽気みたいに、\nいつでもポワポワしてるもんね〜
traducao: Oh, I get it!\nMy head is always breezy and cheery\nlike warm spring sunshine~

original: っておい！　\n誰の頭の中が、\n春の様にお花畑っだっつーの！！
traducao: Wait, hey!\nWho are you calling\nan airhead full of flowers, huh!?

original: そういうノリが……じゃないですか？
traducao: Isn't that attitude proof right there?

original: ロイドが二刀流なのって、\n「剣が二本で二倍強い」って\nアイデアが基だったらしいな
traducao: I heard Lloyd's dual-wielding was\nbased on the idea that having two swords\nmakes you twice as strong!

original: くだらんな
traducao: How utterly ridiculous.

original: 武器の多さが個人の強さに比例するなら\n手練の戦士や騎士のほとんどが\n複数の武器を有している事になる
traducao: If weapon count equaled strength,\nnearly all seasoned knights and warriors\nwould carry multiple armaments.

original: ……そんな絵面を\nお前は見た事があるか？
traducao: ...Have you ever seen\nsuch a sight anywhere?

original: そう言われてみれば\nある様な、無い様な……？
traducao: Now that you mention it,\nmaybe I have, maybe I haven't...?

original: おい、考えるな！\nどう考えてもあるはずがないだろう！
traducao: Hey, don't ponder it!\nThere is no way you ever have!

original: あら、そう？\nでも、客員剣士であるあなたも\n二刀流じゃなかったかしら？
traducao: Oh, really?\nAren't you a dual-wielder yourself,\nSir Guest Swordsman?

original: そういえばそうだな……
traducao: Come to think of it, you are...

original: ちょっと待て……
traducao: Wait just a moment...

original: 客員剣士様が二刀流なのだもの。\n武器の多さは、強さに比例するという仮説も\nあながち的外れではないんじゃないかしら
traducao: Since our guest swordsman dual-wields,\nthe hypothesis that more weapons equal\ngreater strength isn't so far off.

original: うん。\nやっぱり、そうだよな！
traducao: Yeah.\nI knew it was true!

original: リオンはすごい使い手だし\nロイドの考えは正しかったんだ！！
traducao: Leon is an amazing swordsman,\nso Lloyd's theory was right all along!!

original: 僕の戦術を\nあんな単細胞理論と一緒にするな！！
traducao: Do not lump my combat tactics\nin with that simpleton's theory!!

original: なあ、リオン。\n俺、ずっと考えてたんだ……
traducao: Hey, Leon.\nI've been thinking about this a lot...

original: より有利に、相手と戦って勝つには\nどうしたらいいんだろうって
traducao: About how to fight more effectively\nand win against an opponent.

original: ほう。\nお前にしては\n随分殊勝な心がけだな
traducao: Oh?\nThat is an unusually admirable attitude\ncoming from someone like you.

original: ああ。　この間の話で、\n武器の多さが個人の強さになるのは\n何となく納得出来たけど
traducao: Yeah. From our talk the other day,\nI kind of accepted that having more\nweapons adds to individual strength, but

original: 人間の腕は二本しかないだろ？\nって事は、二本以上武器を持てないなら\nどうやって相手より強くなればいいのかな
traducao: humans only have two arms, right?\nIf you can't hold more than two,\nhow can you get stronger than the foe?

original: まだその馬鹿げた話を続けたいのか！
traducao: You still want to continue this nonsense!?

original: そうね。\n単純に武器を増やしただけじゃ\n相手と大きな差は付けられないわ
traducao: That's true.\nSimply increasing weapon count\nwon't create a decisive gap.

original: 武器の数は同じ。\n力も互角。\nそれなら、どうすれば相手に勝てるのか……
traducao: The same number of weapons.\nEqual physical strength.\nThen how does one defeat their foe...?

original: 答えは案外、簡単なところに\nあるんじゃないかしら
traducao: Perhaps the answer is actually\nfound in quite a simple place.

original: 簡単なところ……？\nどういう事だ、ジュディス？\n教えてくれ！
traducao: A simple place...?\nWhat do you mean, Judith?\nTell me!

original: おい、スタン！
traducao: Hey, Stahn!

original: 武器の種類を変えるのよ
traducao: You change the types of weapons.

original: 同じ武器同士ではなく、あえて\n違う武器同士を組み合わせてみるの
traducao: Instead of using two of the same,\ntry combining two different weapons.

original: ほら、斧と剣なんて組み合わせも\n案外、面白い戦い方が\n出来るかもしれないわよ？
traducao: Pairing an axe and sword, for instance,\nmight yield quite an intriguing\nstyle of combat, wouldn't you say?

original: 武器の種類か……！\nうん、確かにそうだな！
traducao: Different weapon types...!\nYeah, that totally makes sense!

original: リオンだって、違う種類の武器で\n戦ってるもんな
traducao: Leon fights with two different\ntypes of weapons too, after all!

original: だから、それとこれとは話が別だ！
traducao: Like I said, that is completely different!

original: こうしちゃいられない！\nこの事、他のみんなにも\n教えて来なくちゃ！！
traducao: I can't just stand around!\nI gotta go tell everyone else\nabout this right away!!

original: 何を考えているか知らんが……、\nあいつをからかって面白がるのはやめろ。\nいい迷惑だ
traducao: I don't know what you're thinking,\nbut stop teasing him for your amusement.\nIt is an utter nuisance.

original: あら、冷たいのね。\n私は冗談は嫌いよ？
traducao: My, how cold.\nI don't care for jokes, you know?

original: ……僕は言葉遊びも大嫌いだ
traducao: ...And I despise wordplay.

original: あらあら……
traducao: My, oh my...

original: ムキになるのは、それだけ本気……\nという事なのかしら？
traducao: Getting so defensive...\nDoes that mean you're truly serious?

original: なあリオン、今度みんなで\nバーベキューしようかって話してるんだ。\n良かったら一緒に……
traducao: Hey, Leon, we're talking about\nhaving a barbecue with everyone soon.\nCare to join us...?

original: 断る
traducao: Refuse

original: そう言うなって。\n焼きたての肉と野菜を\n青空の下で食べると、美味いぞぉ！
traducao: Don't say that!\nFreshly grilled meat and vegetables\nunder the open sky are so delicious!

original: フン、くだらん。\n出来立ての料理なら\n食堂にあるもので十分だろう
traducao: Hmph, absurd.\nIf it is freshly prepared food,\nwhat the cafeteria serves is sufficient.

original: 大体、僕は忙しいんだ。\nお前達の遊びに付き合っ……
traducao: Besides, I am busy.\nI have no time to indulge your games--

original: あ〜そうよねえ。\nあんたは好き嫌いが多いから\nバーベキューなんてつまらないわよねえ
traducao: Aah, right you are.\nYou're such a picky eater, a barbecue\nmust sound boring to you, huh?

original: おい、待て。\n僕がいつ、好き嫌いをしたというんだ
traducao: Wait a second.\nWhen have I ever been a picky eater!?

original: あら、違うの？\nてっきり、ピーマンやにんじんを\n食べたくないんだとばっかり思ったけど
traducao: Oh, you're not?\nI just assumed you didn't want\nto eat bell peppers or carrots.

original: 馬鹿を言うな！\nそんな子どもじみた真似を\n僕がするはずないだろう！
traducao: Don't be ridiculous!\nThere is no way I would ever\nact so childishly!

original: そうかしら？\nこんなに協調性がない大人も\n珍しいと思うけどね〜？
traducao: Is that so?\nIt's pretty rare to see an adult\nwith so little cooperativeness, though~

original: ま、まあまあ、いいじゃないか。\n仲良くみんなで食べればさ。\nなっ！
traducao: C-Come on, isn't it fine?\nWe can all eat together as friends.\nRight!?

original: おい、僕は参加するとは\n言っていないぞ！
traducao: Hey, I never said\nI would participate!

original: 何よ。\n逃げるの？
traducao: What?\nRunning away?

original: 誰が逃げるか！
traducao: As if I would run away!

original: あなたがリオンさんですね。\nお目にかかれて光栄です
traducao: You must be Leon.\nIt is an honor to meet you.

original: 僕を知っているのか
traducao: You know who I am?

original: ええ。\nかの国の薔薇と名高い……
traducao: Indeed.\nFamed as the Rose of that kingdom...

original: 黙れ。\n人違いだ
traducao: Silence.\nYou have the wrong person.

original: そうですか？\nまあ、確かにそのリオンさんは\n男装の麗人という話でしたしね
traducao: Is that so?\nThough that Leon was said to be\na cross-dressing beauty, after all.

original: ぼくの勘違い……という事にしておきます
traducao: I'll consider it... my mistake.

original: あなたが男装をしている、という\n線も残っていますけどね
traducao: Though the possibility remains that\nyou are a maiden in men's clothes.

original: あるはずがないだろう！！
traducao: As if that could ever be true!!

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 怒り。\n
traducao: Anger.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 悲しみ。\n
traducao: Sadness.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: すねる。\n
traducao: Sulking.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
